name: UK flood warnings
summary: One Environment Agency flood warning in England on 22 Nov, for the South Devon coast; 25 flood alerts
state: The Environment Agency had one flood warning in force in England at 05:41 UTC on 22 Nov, for the South Devon coast at Beesands, Torcross, Slapton and Dawlish, no severe flood warnings and 25 lower-level flood alerts (Environment Agency). This is well within the Normal band of fewer than 10 flood warnings.
for_you: If you are on the South Devon coast, check the Environment Agency's flood warning service and follow its advice.
why: Flooding is the UK's most common natural hazard; Environment Agency flood warnings are separate from Met Office weather warnings.
drivers: Heavy rain, saturated ground, storm surges, high river levels.

rubric.alert: Any severe flood warning (danger to life) in force in the UK.
rubric.watch: 10 or more flood warnings in force in England, or major flooding in Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland.
rubric.normal: No severe flood warnings and fewer than 10 Environment Agency flood warnings in force.
